title: sutra_trend — snapshot diff + aggregate metrics
description:
Extend the existing snapshot table to record aggregate metrics per parse run (total complexity, dead-symbol count, hotspot count, workspace health score). Add `sutra_trend(from, to)` that returns deltas.

Existing snapshot table already records files_parsed, symbols_extracted, refs_extracted, parse_errors, duration_ms — this just adds the aggregate roll-ups and a diff endpoint.

Useful for CI gates ("fail if health dropped") and pre/post-refactor checks.

See docs/feature-ideas.md → "sutra_trend".

**Independent of other simple-additions tasks** — schema migration + new tool.

acceptance_criteria.text: Snapshot schema records aggregate metrics each parse run
Default 'from' resolves to most recent prior snapshot

decisions: Hotspot count uses blast_radius >= 5 AND avg_cognitive >= 5.0 as DB proxy instead of git-churn-based calculation — avoids shelling out to git during parse
Health score is average per-file health across all files using the same formula as sutra_file_health
Total complexity sums avg_cognitive per file (not raw sum of all symbol cognitive values) to stay consistent with file_health weighting
